articles.summary: First Financial Bank, a subsidiary of First Financial Bankshares, Inc. (NASDAQ: FFIN), has promoted Frank Gioia to Chief Digital and Innovation Officer. The new senior leadership position reflects First Financial's commitment to modernizing operations, expanding digital and artificial intelligence capabilities, and leveraging emerging technologies to support long-term growth and enhance customer and employee experiences. "As banking continues to evolve, we see tremendous opportunities to use artificial intelligence, automation and digital technology to better serve customers, empower employees and operate more efficiently," said David Bailey, President and Chief Executive Officer of First Financial Bank. "We've made meaningful progress, and this position will help us build on that momentum. articles.title: FIRST FINANCIAL ANNOUNCES PROMOTION OF FRANK GIOIA TO CHIEF DIGITAL AND INNOVATION OFFICER
